prompt: A photorealistic photo captures a lively rooftop terrace during golden hour, with warm sunlight casting long shadows across the wooden deck. In the foreground, a group of friends gathers around a low glass table. A woman in a silk emerald dress pours red wine from a bottle into crystal glasses held by two men seated on plush beige cushions. To the left, a chef in a white uniform plates a colorful salad on a ceramic dish, while a waiter in a black vest carries a tray of appetizers past him. A golden retriever sits patiently next to the table, looking up at a guest who is offering a piece of bread. On the right, a couple leans against the metal railing, gazing at the city skyline illuminated by twilight lights. Potted olive trees in terracotta pots line the perimeter, adding greenery to the urban setting. String lights hang overhead, glowing softly against the deepening blue sky. The interactions include pouring, holding, carrying, offering, looking, and leaning, creating a dynamic social scene. High-resolution details reveal the texture of the wood, the condensation on the wine glasses, and the fabric folds of the clothing, ensuring every element is distinct and physically plausible within the square composition.
